plan_review.notes: Adopted bounded reach-aware wounded orbit at 30% reach clamped 10-14ft instead of uncapped half reach; retained healthy 6ft orbit. Pressure entry uses max(rangedSafeDistance, defensiveOrbit+approachBuffer), release uses the explicit RANGED_DEFENSIVE_RELEASE_MULTIPLIER=2, limiting bow release to about 32.4ft. Added explicit RETREAT-time/transition oracle and a multi-enemy multi-poll no-snapback regression.

independent_grade.notes: The change flawlessly implements weapon-reach-aware wounded ranged spacing. It calculates defensiveOrbit with the correct bounds (30% reach, clamped 10-14ft, and never below healthyOrbit), scales the pressure radius seamlessly to include the approach buffer, and uses the correct hysteresis multiplier to prevent AI snapback. It adds focused tests for the new behaviors (reach scaling and multi-threat latching) while preserving existing test validity. The diff is surgically scoped, policy-compliant, and well-written.
